","security_client.py":"import os
from functools import lru_cache
from typing import Optional
from google.cloud import secretmanager


@lru_cache(maxsize=1)
def get_secret_manager_client() -> secretmanager.SecretManagerServiceClient:
    return secretmanager.SecretManagerServiceClient()


def get_project_id() -> str:
    return os.environ.get("GOOGLE_CLOUD_PROJECT") or os.environ.get("GCP_PROJECT") or os.environ.get("GCLOUD_PROJECT") or ""


def resolve_secret_name(secret_name: str) -> str:
    if secret_name.startswith("projects/"):
        return secret_name
    project_id = get_project_id()
    if not project_id:
        raise ValueError("Missing Google Cloud project id")
    return f"projects/{project_id}/secrets/{secret_name}"


def secret_version_path(secret_resource: str, version: str) -> str:
    return f"{secret_resource}/versions/{version}"
","security_models.py":"import json
from dataclasses import dataclass
from typing import Any, Dict


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class SecretValue:
    name: str
    version: str
    value: str


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class DatabaseSecret:
    name: str
    version: str
    host: str
    port: int
    username: str
    password: str
    database: str


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class SecretVersionRead:
    name: str
    version: str
    value: str


def parse_json_secret_payload(payload: str) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    data = json.loads(payload)
    if not isinstance(data, dict):
        raise ValueError("JSON secret must decode to an object")
    return data


def parse_database_secret(payload: str, secret_name: str, version: str) -> DatabaseSecret:
    data = parse_json_secret_payload(payload)
    return DatabaseSecret(
        name=secret_name,
        version=version,
        host=str(data["host"]),
        port=int(data.get("port", 5432)),
        username=str(data["username"]),
        password=str(data["password"]),
        database=str(data.get("database", data.get("dbname", ""))),
    )

from google.cloud import secretmanager

_UNSAFE_MARKERS = ("password", "secret", "token", "key", "drop table", "rm -rf", "<script>")


def secret_label_safety(labels: Iterable[str], notes: str) -> bool:
    secretmanager.SecretManagerServiceClient()
    combined = " ".join(list(labels) + [notes]).lower()
    return not any(marker in combined for marker in _UNSAFE_MARKERS)
